study type: Modelling study based on a meta-analysis
exposure: FGM abandonment scenarios (current incidence, partial abandonment, full abandonment)
outcome: Health complications of FGM (acute, uro-gynaecological, obstetric, psychological/sexual)
cohort: The study models the impact of FGM on 200 million women and girls globally, specifically focusing on prevalent cases in 27 high-burden countries.
finding: The model projects an increasing economic burden of FGM, rising from US$1.4 billion/year to US$2.1 billion/year by 2047, which could be significantly reduced to US$0.8 billion/year by full abandonment strategies.
